violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

(Grilled chicken) was observed held at (45) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC moved to another unit for active cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026
Shredded cheese was observed being stored in cardboard box.PIC informed to cease practice. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

Single service items are not being stored properly in their original protective package and/or are stored on a surface that is not clean in the (prep ) area. Single service containers observed being used to store food product. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

The cutting boards in the (prep area ) are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -prep table shelves -equipment shelves -dry food storage bins -exterior of refrigerator units New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026
The floors in kitchen have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025

Raw animal foods (shelled eggs and sausage) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (bagged lettuce and container of spaghetti sauce) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025

The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was (0) parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025
Shredded cheese observed being stored in a cardboard box. PIC instructed to place cheese in food grade container and cease practice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/20/2025
